status: DRAFT — NOT FROZEN. Per protocol.t2_expert_audit.v1 freeze_ordering step 4, this protocol is frozen (renamed to protocol.t2_training.v1.json, sha256 companion written, DRAFT markers removed, TBD_* fields resolved) only AFTER expert_source_feasibility.place_container_plate.v1.json exists. Everything in binding_commitments is already binding via the frozen audit protocol and may not be weakened here; only TBD_* fields may be filled in.

protocol.t2_expert_audit.v1.json.role: audit protocol; its t2_design_commitments are inherited verbatim

capability_cells.place_container_plate.v.sha256: TBD_AT_FREEZE — generated by make_capability_cells.py before the probe
capability_cells.place_container_plate.v.role: cells, rankings, fallback orders, eval seed -> cell mapping

expert_source_feasibility.place_containe.sha256: TBD_AT_FREEZE — probe output; must exist before this protocol freezes
expert_source_feasibility.place_containe.role: feasible set; per-seed expert trajectories entering pool D_X

t2_selection.place_container_plate.v1.js.role: frozen arm compositions (Cover/Random/Self-Diverse) and dose points

protocol.t1d.v1.1.json.role: matched-training rules inherited: S_star rule, dose semantics, per-sample overuse bound, frozen Base200 600.ckpt initialization

arm_definitions.Zero: zero-dose optimizer-only point: same S_star gradient steps on the frozen Base200 mixture with rho = 0 new data. Identical to the T1d zero-dose semantics.
arm_definitions.Self-Diverse-12: 12 T1c D_H self-trajectories chosen by the frozen round-robin diversity rule in select_cover12.py (distinct successful seeds ascending, then attempt_index ascending). Controls for 'any 12 hard-seed trajectories' vs expert provenance.
arm_definitions.Expert-Random-12: 12 expert trajectories uniform without replacement from the feasible set, random.Random(20260818). Controls for coverage vs mere expert provenance.
arm_definitions.Expert-Cover-12: the cell-covering selection from the frozen fallback-completed rule.

secondary: Expert-Cover-12 vs Expert-Random-12 — MUST be adequately powered before the paper may claim cover > random; if underpowered, the claim is limited to 'expert data helps' without a coverage mechanism claim.

exposure.reporting: BOTH w_source and w_traj reported for every arm in the run report; w_traj is the binding constraint.

dose_curve.q6_rule: first 6 slots of Expert-Cover-12 in frozen cell order; exists only as a dose point, never the sole surviving design
dose_curve.q20_rule: Cover-12 + next 8 feasible seeds from the frozen global ranking; DROPPED (recorded, not substituted) if feasible < 20
dose_curve.rho_at_each_q: rho = 0.15 at every Q; dose varies by Q (trajectory count), exposure per trajectory varies as w_traj = 200*0.15/(Q*0.85), all <= 3 for Q >= 12; at Q = 6 w_traj = 5.88 EXCEEDS the cap, so the Q=6 point instead uses rho chosen to hold w_traj = 3: rho_q6 = 3*6/(200+3*6) = 0.0826. This keeps per-trajectory exposure matched across dose points rather than total exposure.
dose_curve.ess_labeling: an arm is labeled an ESS rescue only if realized n_eff >= 10 per the select_cover12.py arithmetic (accounts for prior self-success counts of selected seeds).

paired_training.rule: all arms and dose points share IDENTICAL training seeds; inference on per-seed differences D_k = J_arm(k) - J_ref(k)
paired_training.seed_count: TBD_AT_FREEZE by the power analysis below; never below the floor

matched_training.inherit: protocol.t1d.v1.1 matched_training_rule verbatim: same S_star, batch size, LR schedule, optimizer, initialization (frozen Base200 600.ckpt) for every arm including Zero
matched_training.dose_semantics: rho is a sampling proportion at fixed S_star; remainder of each batch is the frozen Base200 rehearsal set; never dataset-size or step-count changes

evaluation.eval_seed_to_cell: from the frozen cells file; NEVER recomputed after training
evaluation.delta_h_split: Delta_H decomposed into within-cell (eval seeds sharing a cell with >= 1 training-selected seed) vs cross-cell (all other hard eval seeds); train-seed-only effects reported separately

interpretation_table.within_only: gain concentrated on within-cell eval seeds, cross-cell ~ 0: capability transport is LOCAL — targeted acquisition works but claims must be cell-scoped
interpretation_table.within_plus_related: within-cell gain plus attenuated gain on frozen fallback-neighbor cells: GRADED transport along the frozen cell metric
interpretation_table.broad: comparable within- and cross-cell gain: transport is GLOBAL; coverage design was sufficient but not necessary at this Q
interpretation_table.train_seed_only: gain only on the 12 training seeds themselves, other within-cell seeds flat: MEMORIZATION, not capability transport; the cover > random claim is void regardless of the aggregate contrast

evaluation.eval_protocol: TBD_AT_FREEZE: repeats per eval seed, eval seed list (all 50 hard + frozen E/M panels for regression detection), success criterion unchanged from T1

language.zero_success_seeds: 'empirically unsupported' / 'not harvestable under the frozen budget' with one-sided p_upper = 1 - 0.05^(1/n); never 'impossible'
language.claims_scope: no semantic-skill claims; cells are geometry strata, transport claims are stratum-scoped

tbd_at_freeze.power_analysis: paired-seed count K from the T1d variance estimates of D_k on hard-seed panels; K chosen so the primary contrasts have >= 80% power at the pre-specified minimum effect; if the secondary Cover-vs-Random contrast is underpowered at that K, the protocol must either raise K or pre-commit to not claiming cover > random
tbd_at_freeze.minimum_effect_size: pre-specified before unblinding any T2 eval result, in units of hard-panel success-rate difference
tbd_at_freeze.s_star: resolved integer from the T1d launch config (same rule: round(0.15 * S_base200))
tbd_at_freeze.launch_config: t2_launch_config.json + sha256 BEFORE the first arm trains, mirroring t1d_launch_config.json
tbd_at_freeze.q20_status: resolved from the audit output feasible count
tbd_at_freeze.test_statistics: paired test on D_k (primary: sign-flip permutation on seed pairs; report Wilcoxon as sensitivity), multiplicity correction across the two primary contrasts

explicit_rejections.no_reordering: cells, rankings, fallback orders, and arm compositions may not change after the probe output exists; any edit voids the T2 preregistration
explicit_rejections.no_cap_rescue: if Cover-12 is infeasible, T2 does not launch under this design; no attempt-cap increases or re-probes
explicit_rejections.no_unpaired_inference: aggregate success-rate comparisons across arms without seed pairing are exploratory only
